examShortTricks: rDNA = 7 steps: Isolate, Cut, Ligate, Transform, Select, Express, Harvest.
Plasmid = ori + marker + MCS + copy number.
Insulin = E. coli = bacteria make human protein.
Gene therapy = give the gene; Gene editing = cut + paste the gene (CRISPR).
Bt = Bacillus thuringiensis = insect toxin = transgenic crop.
GMO = Gene from another organism → Modified.
Use diagrams to understand Biotechnology in Microbiology.
